Cc: Tom Greer <tom.greer@peregrine.ai>
Date: 2027-12-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Severe latency + errors during peak window (Dec 3 evening)

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick bridge earlier. Wanted to capture what we saw in case it helps your post-incident review: on Dec 3 between 18:05–18:22 PST our production calls to the Redwood hosted inference for the /v1/generate endpoint spiked in p95 latency from ~120ms to 1.8s and token error rates jumped from 0.2% to ~4.6%. Throughput dropped for a subset of requests and we saw downstream timeouts in our API layer.

We collected request/response ids and some traces (attached) and our SRE has a short list of impact customers. Immediate ask: we need an RCA and a written remediation plan we can present to our CTO this week. Also please confirm what mitigations are live or scheduled that will prevent recurrence.

Attachments: perf-traces-peregrine-20271204.zip (request ids + traces)

Lena
VP of Engineering
Peregrine AI

Subject: Re: Severe latency + errors during peak window (Dec 3 evening)

Lena — thanks for the data and for escalating. We’re treating this with high priority; I’ve pulled the on-call infra and serving leads into the loop.}

Quick summary of next steps from our side: 
- Immediate: we’ve isolated two correlated signals in the serving runtime (KV-cache thrashing for certain request prefixes + a scheduling edge-case that increased per-request CPU contention). We’ve applied a short-term routing rule to move your most-latent traffic to a warmed pool (effective now).
- Today: drafting a formal RCA and a targeted corrective action plan for you (will share v1 by EOD tomorrow).
- Dec 7, 11:00am PST: propose a 30-min exec readout to review RCA, actions, and a compensatory SLA discussion. Can you confirm availability?

We will include concrete mitigations (canary config changes, a small kernel fix, and a short cache-policy update) and owners for each item.

I’ll send the RCA draft to you and internal stakeholders for signoff.

— Jonas
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
message_3:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-12-04T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Peregrine RCA v1 — owners and deadlines (internal)

Team —

I’ve attached the initial notes from the investigation (and Lena’s traces). Need owners and firm dates so we can turn this into a customer-facing RCA. High level: 
1) Root causes: KV-cache eviction pattern under skewed prefix distribution; scheduler mis-prioritizing low-latency pools for concurrent long sequences.
2) Immediate mitigations already applied: traffic routing to warmed pool (Jonas), temporary per-customer concurrency caps (Ben).
3) Permanent fixes proposed: a) scheduler patch to respect pool affinity (owner: Karthik) — target: 2027-12-14 for PR; b) cache policy change + hot-prefix pinning (owner: Marissa) — target: 2027-12-10 for canary; c) better observability: add prefix-level heatmaps and alert (owner: Kimberly) — target: 2027-12-09.

Please confirm owners and feasibility. We need to include precise rollback and verification steps in the external RCA.

Jonas
